shown_command: T=$(curl -s -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60"); m() { curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $T" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/$1; }; echo "instance-type : $(m instance-type)"; echo "instance-id   : $(m instance-id)"; echo "ami-id        : $(m ami-id)"; echo "az            : $(m placement/availability-zone)"; echo "lifecycle     : $(m instance-life-cycle)"; uname -srm; grep PRETTY_NAME /etc/os-release; lscpu | grep -E "Model name|^CPU\(s\)|Architecture"; free -m | sed -n 1,2p
